'''Dwess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] merchant in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Con artist/Legends|con man]], offering to sell spice at a discounted rate to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who could then sell the spice to any number of dealers. In reality he would take a good faith deposit, set up a meeting where the spice was to be delivered and the remainder of the payment made, and then take the deposit money and run. While [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] normally was quite harsh with those who sought to sell spice on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] without working through him, he considered those scammed by Dwess much more useful hunting down the con man.<ref name="SRG" />
